xmldoc.short_description: Sets the value of persistent preferences.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector or scalar string: the group name. It must be a valid variable name.
a character vector or scalar string: one preference name, or a cell array of character vectors or a string array: several preference names. Each name must be a valid variable name.
any value when pref is a single name, or a cell array with one value for each name when pref holds several names.

description.p: setpref(group, pref, value) stores value in the preference pref of group. The group and the preference are created when they do not exist, and an existing value is replaced.

The value can be of any type that Nelson can save (numeric, logical, text, cell, struct, ...). It is written immediately in the file preferences.nh5 of the preferences directory (see prefdir), so it is kept for the next Nelson session.
When several names are given, value must be a cell array with the same number of elements, otherwise an error is raised.

example_item.example_item_description: Store, replace and read preferences, then remove the group.
